newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Samper axes deputy energy minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Samper axes deputy energy minister.

text.p: President Ernesto Samper fired Colombia's deputy minister of Mines and Energy on Wednesday on grounds that he misappropriated an official helicopter to attend an opposition political rally.

"The national government hopes this decision is a clear warning to all public officials that state property cannot be used, directly or indirectly, for political campaign purposes," a statement from the presidential palace said.
It said Samper had demanded the resignation of Luis Armando Galvis Valles, a member of the opposition Conservative Party, with immediate effect.
